stages.title: Domain package and CLI compatibility

stages.title: CLI, streaming, checkpointing, and HITL

stages.title: Final loop acceptance

stages.title: Codex CLI decision engine

stages.title: New-pattern curriculum sweep
acceptance_commands: live Agent Server pattern-card and continue smoke
evidence: 31 offline tests passed; sweep next selected the first wholly untouched pattern (linked-list) instead of the due Group Anagrams review; live Agent Chat paused at pattern_card with the linked-list card, then continued to fixed-gap/dummy and Remove Nth Node From End of List in pattern-contrast mode; stale pre-upgrade due/current selections are discarded when a pattern-sweep thread resumes; no pending write or graph error occurred; Makefile now validates both study and sweep contracts; protected-path aggregate remained 2221b7d831a4eda1345d3a384212c95e8a2d667f7135e4cc9fc8ba4886b14956

stages.title: Bootstrap control-intent routing
evidence: 33 offline tests passed; exact first message '切换到题型扫荡模式' deterministically bypassed bootstrap and produced phase=pattern_card, routing_mode=pattern-sweep, selected_problem=null, and the linked-list card; the observed Group Anagrams failure was traced to START routing the initial message directly to load_context; mode questions do not trigger the command parser; no pending write or server error occurred; protected-path aggregate remained 2221b7d831a4eda1345d3a384212c95e8a2d667f7135e4cc9fc8ba4886b14956

stages.title: Phase-safe semantic transitions
acceptance_commands: live /sweep → AC → incomplete teach-back → blocked next-subpattern trajectory
evidence: 39 offline tests passed; Agent Chat content blocks normalize before deterministic commands; coaching uses TurnDecision while teach-back uses a separate TeachBackDecision and node; completion is derived only from four assessment booleans; explicit AC reports create judge_result=AC without model interpretation; live incomplete assessment remained phase=teach_back with no pending write; live next-subpattern request was rejected while attempt_recorded=false; fake complete trajectory still reached approval, persistence, sync, and completion; service health returned 200; protected-path aggregate remained 2221b7d831a4eda1345d3a384212c95e8a2d667f7135e4cc9fc8ba4886b14956

stages.title: Natural-language AC recovery
acceptance_commands: live Agent Server historical English-AC recovery smoke
evidence: 40 offline tests passed; natural-language reports including exact phrase 'too many questiones. No 19 got ac' are recognized as deterministic AC events while English negations are rejected; a missed AC in recent thread history is recovered before teach-back assessment; live recovery set judge_result=AC, kept incomplete teach-back in phase=teach_back, and created no pending write; service health returned 200; scoped diff check passed; protected-path aggregate remained 2221b7d831a4eda1345d3a384212c95e8a2d667f7135e4cc9fc8ba4886b14956; repository-wide diff check only reported pre-existing trailing whitespace in protected solution.py

stages.title: Visible chat feedback during approval interrupts
evidence: 42 offline tests passed; latest thread diagnosis confirmed phase=awaiting_approval with archive_solution pending and a second '下一题' human message but no assistant response; ordinary chat during HITL now emits a visible pending-action notice and re-presents the interrupt; exact chat commands approve/reject provide a fallback when UI controls are hidden, while '下一题' cannot imply approval; service health returned 200; protected-path aggregate remained 2221b7d831a4eda1345d3a384212c95e8a2d667f7135e4cc9fc8ba4886b14956

stages.title: Thin graph and unified completion transaction
evidence: 45 offline tests passed; TurnDecision now represents conversational intents including teach_back and select_next instead of mirroring every phase; a fresh live thread answered the first-message progress question with 18 total, 16 AC, 2 Todo, and 9 due without selecting a problem or creating a pending write; complete teach-back creates one complete_attempt preview for archive, attempt, sweep, and session changes; one approval executes the grouped operation and a simulated mid-transaction failure restored every protected file; legacy archive/finish/sync pending checkpoints migrate to the unified preview; idle checkpoints no longer replay the last human turn; Agent Server health returned 200.
